aboutBrandTitle: Brand Philosophy & Etymology - Brand Philosophy & Etymology
aboutPhilosophy: Diaspora - A word for people living beyond their place of origin.
Paradiso - Italian for "paradise" and an anagrammatic response to diaspora. It offers a calmer greeting to people arriving in Korea with their own meanings and dreams.
aboutStartBody: Korea has 39 residence statuses, but the relevant laws and manuals are spread across many sources. Paradiso structures scattered visa and residence information into a user-centered guidance flow that reduces information asymmetry.
aboutValuesBody: Beyond listing information, Paradiso is designed to reduce search burden through structured residence data and user-context guidance that naturally leads back to official verification.
aboutValueDesc: Uses Korea Immigration Service manuals and regulations as primary references.
Groups 39 residence statuses by purpose so users can compare and explore them in one place.
Suggests statuses and check flows based on the situation a user enters.

f4RouteTitle: Which F-4 route applies to you?
f4RouteIntro: F-4 can involve different routes, including pre-entry visa issuance, domestic status change, domestic residence reporting, and extension of stay. Confirm which route matches your situation first.
f4RouteSourceNote: Selecting a route does not imply eligibility or approval. Confirm actual applicability with HiKorea, 1345, or the competent immigration office.
f4RouteNoDocsNote: This route does not yet have a source-backed document checklist. Confirm directly with HiKorea, 1345, or the competent immigration office.
f4Route1Label: Entering with an F-4 visa issued by a Korean mission abroad
f4Route2Label: Changing to F-4 in Korea after entering with B-2, C-3, or another eligible status
f4Route1Desc: You obtain an F-4 visa through a Korean diplomatic mission abroad before entering Korea. Confirm visa-issuance requirements and documents with the mission and HiKorea.
f4Route2Desc: After entering on B-2, C-3, or another eligible status, you change your status of stay to F-4 inside Korea. Confirm eligibility and documents with the competent immigration office.
f4Route3Desc: You change from H-2 (Working Visit) to F-4. Confirm eligibility and required documents with the competent immigration office.
f4Route4Desc: Overseas Koreans (F-4) may file a domestic residence report, which is distinct from a general foreigner registration. Confirm who must report, the deadline, and documents with the competent office.
f4Route5Desc: To stay beyond your current F-4 permitted period, extension of stay permission may be required. Check well before your expiry date.
f4ApplicationForm: Application Form for Overseas Koreans (F-4) (Attached Form No. 1, Enforcement Rules of the Overseas Koreans Act)
f6RouteTitle: Which F-6 situation applies to you?
f6RouteIntro: F-6 procedures and documents may differ depending on whether you are applying as a spouse of a Korean national, a child-raising parent, or under a marriage-breakdown situation. Select the situation closest to yours first.
f6Route1Label: Spouse of a Korean national / marriage maintained
f6Route4Label: Death, disappearance, or other reasons not attributable to you
f6Route1Desc: For those maintaining a genuine marriage as the spouse of a Korean national. Confirm who qualifies and which documents apply with the competent immigration office.
f6Route2Desc: May apply when you are raising a child who is a Korean national. Whether child-rearing is recognized, and the documents required, must be confirmed with the competent office. Child-rearing alone is not automatically approved.
f6Route3Desc: For cases where the marriage has broken down through divorce or separation. Recognition has conditions, such as the breakdown not being attributable to you, and not every breakdown case qualifies. Confirm with the competent office.
f6Route4Desc: For cases where the marriage cannot continue due to the death or disappearance of the spouse, or other reasons not attributable to you. Confirm recognition conditions and documents with the competent office.
f6Route5Desc: To stay beyond your current F-6 permitted period, extension of stay permission may be required. Check with the competent office well before your expiry date.
g1RouteTitle: Which G-1 reason applies to you?
g1RouteIntro: G-1 procedures and documents may differ significantly depending on the reason, such as refugee application, humanitarian stay, litigation, medical treatment, or industrial accident. Select the reason closest to your situation first.
g1Route5Label: Industrial accident, unpaid wages, or other protected-stay reason
g1Route1Desc: For stay related to a refugee application or refugee status. Refugee recognition is decided through a separate review, and choosing this route does not guarantee recognition. Confirm with the competent office or refugee division.
g1Route2Desc: For humanitarian stay. Whether humanitarian stay is granted is decided through review and is not guaranteed. Confirm with the competent office.
g1Route3Desc: For stay to pursue litigation or other rights-remedy procedures. Confirm recognition conditions and documents with the competent office.
g1Route4Desc: For stay for medical treatment or other health-related purposes. Confirm who qualifies and which documents apply with the competent office.
g1Route5Desc: For stay under protected reasons such as industrial-accident claims or treatment, or unpaid-wage remedies. Confirm recognition conditions and documents with the competent office.
g1Route6Desc: To stay beyond your current G-1 permitted period, extension of stay permission may be required. Procedures differ by reason, so confirm with the competent office.
f2RouteTitle: Which F-2 route applies to you?
f2RouteIntro: F-2 requirements and documents may differ by subtype. Select the route closest to your situation.
f2Route1Label: Minor foreign child of a Korean national (F-2-2)
f2Route2Label: Spouse or minor child of an F-5 holder
f2Route1Desc: F-2-2 status-change route for a minor foreign child of a Korean national. Confirm family-relationship and custody requirements with the competent office.
f2Route2Desc: Status-change route for a spouse or minor child of an F-5 holder. Confirm applicability and documents with the competent office.
f2Route3Desc: F-2-7 point-based talent status-change route. Confirm points and detailed requirements with the competent office.
f2Route4Desc: F-2-7S potential-talent status-change route. Confirm school, recommendation, and point requirements with the competent office.
f2Route5Desc: F-2-8 tourism or resort investment status-change route. Confirm investment requirements and documents with the competent office.
f2Route6Desc: F-2-12·13·14 public-interest investment status-change route. Confirm the applicable subtype and investment requirements with the competent office.
f2Route7Desc: If you plan to stay beyond your current F-2 period, confirm whether an extension permit is required.
d10RouteTitle: Which D-10 route applies to you?
d10RouteIntro: D-10 procedures may differ by purpose and application stage, including job seeking, technology start-up preparation, and high-tech internship.
d10Route1Label: Change to D-10-1 point-based job seeking
d10Route2Label: First D-10-1 job-seeking change after domestic graduation
d10Route3Label: Change to D-10-2 technology start-up preparation
d10Route1Desc: D-10-1 point-based job-seeking status-change route. Confirm points and detailed requirements with the competent office.
d10Route2Desc: First D-10-1 job-seeking change after domestic graduation. Confirm graduation and application requirements with the competent office.
d10Route3Desc: D-10-2 technology start-up preparation status-change route. Confirm preparation requirements and documents with the competent office.
d10Route4Desc: D-10-3 high-tech internship status-change route. Confirm eligible fields and internship requirements with the competent office.
d10Route5Desc: D-10-1 point-based job-seeking extension route. Confirm eligibility and period with the competent office.
d10Route6Desc: D-10-2 technology start-up preparation extension route. Confirm eligibility and documents with the competent office.
d10Route7Desc: D-10-3 high-tech internship extension route. Confirm eligibility and documents with the competent office.
h2RouteTitle: Which H-2 procedure do you need?
h2RouteIntro: H-2 can involve separate procedures for foreigner registration, employment-start or workplace-change reporting, and extension of stay.
h2Route1Label: Foreigner registration for an existing H-2 holder
h2Route1Desc: Foreigner-registration route for an existing H-2 holder. Confirm applicability, deadline, and documents with the competent office.
h2Route2Desc: H-2 employment-start or workplace-change reporting route. Confirm reporting scope and deadline with the competent office.
h2Route3Desc: If you plan to stay beyond your current H-2 period, confirm whether an extension permit is required.
e7RouteTitle: Which E-7 procedure do you need?
e7RouteIntro: E-7 may involve foreigner registration, a registered workplace addition or change report, or an extension of stay. Select the procedure you need.
e7Route2Label: Registered E-7 workplace addition or change report
e7Route1Desc: Foreigner-registration route for a long-term E-7 holder. Confirm applicability, deadline, and documents with the competent office.
e7Route2Desc: Workplace addition or change report route for a registered E-7 holder. Confirm whether reporting or permission applies and confirm the deadline with the competent office.
e7Route3Desc: If you plan to stay beyond your current E-7 period, confirm whether an extension permission is required.
d4RouteTitle: Which D-4 route applies to you?
d4RouteIntro: D-4 procedures and documents may differ by training subtype and application stage. Select the route closest to your situation.
d4Route1Label: Change to D-4-1 or D-4-7 language training
d4Route1Desc: D-4-1 or D-4-7 language-training status-change route. Confirm the applicable subtype and documents with the competent office.
d4Route2Desc: D-4-2 post-graduation-training status-change route. Confirm requirements and documents with the competent office.
d4Route3Desc: D-4-3 student-training status-change route. Confirm requirements and documents with the competent office.
d4Route4Desc: If you plan to stay beyond your current D-4 period, confirm whether an extension permission is required.
f1RouteTitle: Which F-1 route applies to you?
f1RouteIntro: F-1 procedures and documents may differ by family relationship, birth, refugee-family reason, and application stage.
f1Route6Label: Status grant for a Korea-born child of an employment-status parent
f1Route7Label: Status grant for a Korea-born child of a refugee
f1Route1Desc: F-1-13 status-change route. Confirm applicability and documents with the competent office.
f1Route2Desc: F-1-6 marriage-cleanup-related status-change route. Confirm applicability and documents with the competent office.
f1Route3Desc: F-1 status-change route related to a nationality procedure such as acquisition or loss. Confirm applicability and documents with the competent office.
f1Route4Desc: F-1-16 refugee-family status-change route. Confirm the family relationship and requirements with the competent office.
f1Route5Desc: F-1-52 prior-marriage-child status-change route. Confirm applicability and documents with the competent office.
f1Route6Desc: Status-grant route for a Korea-born child of a parent with employment status. Confirm the reporting deadline and documents with the competent office.
f1Route7Desc: Status-grant route for a Korea-born child of a refugee. Confirm the reporting deadline and documents with the competent office.
f1Route8Desc: If you plan to stay beyond your current F-1 period, confirm whether an extension permission is required.
